title: Lanes on the same busy file go in back-to-back stacked batches
why: Plan R26 part 4 (owner; restart-plan). Owner 13:15 CST Nov 12: "how do you propose us getting the merge queue faster?"
note: Lanes that change the same busy file go in back-to-back stacked batches, not one batch, so a conflict in one does not drop the rest. Plan R55 (owner 13:19 and 13:21 CST Nov 12, restart-plan 4fefc9f, pick d: "Express lane, and cancel a running batch for it too"): a reviewed merge-flow lane goes to main as its own batch, ahead of all others; the batch runner cancels a batch run already in CI, and that batch then merges main in. Home: decision no-merge-during-batch-ci; skill ci-hygiene step 8 points to it (retrospective 13:23 CST, plan b152ca6). The owner chose this over the one-batch-in-turn rule.
